page.overview:
Who is Wesley Rhoades' friend?

The friend of Wesley Rhoades is a minor character who appeared in Rob Zombie's .

This boy was close friends with Wesley Rhoades around 1990. They were both bullies at Haddonfield Elementary School and one of their targets was a 10-year-old Michael Myers. This character was not killed by Michael, unlike his friend, who was Michael's first human victim, and his fate afterwards remains unknown.
